reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume doubled from July to August 2026 and remains elevated (610→590→1180→1260 monthly, E-02); the majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025) are tied to ACTUAL meter reads rather than ESTIMATED substitutes (E-04), which rules out meter-read-collection, AMI-delivery, field-staffing and ticket-response-speed explanations (E-01, E-04) and points to a defect in the billing import validation step — candidate mechanism: a billing import validation rule change around August (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE) — as the surviving causal driver. No tariff change occurred in this period (E-05), further narrowing the cause to billing calculation/validation logic rather than rate changes.
